title: Capital Region Ring Road — Package I: Rameshwar to Bilipada (40 km)
address: Rameshwar to Bilipada, Greenfield 6-lane Access-Controlled Highway (NH bypass)
authority: NHAI - National Highways Authority of India
funding_source: Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) — NHAI Capital Budget
notes: One of three packages of the Capital Region Ring Road (CRRR) — total project cost ₹8,307.74 crore. Letter of Award issued March 2026. 30-month construction timeline. Designed to decongest Bhubaneswar-Cuttack-Khordha urban area by diverting through traffic. Land acquisition 96% complete.

title: Capital Region Ring Road — Package II: Bilipada to Gobindpur (30 km)
address: Bilipada to Gobindpur, Greenfield 6-lane Access-Controlled Highway
authority: NHAI - National Highways Authority of India
funding_source: Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) — NHAI Capital Budget
notes: Part of 111-km Capital Region Ring Road. Total project ₹8,307.74 crore. LOA issued March 2026. Forest, wildlife, and environmental clearances obtained.

title: Capital Region Ring Road — Package III: Gobindpur to Tangi (40 km)
address: Gobindpur to Tangi, Greenfield 6-lane Access-Controlled Highway
authority: NHAI - National Highways Authority of India
funding_source: Hybrid Annuity Mode (HAM) — NHAI Capital Budget
notes: Part of 111-km Capital Region Ring Road. Connects Gobindpur to Tangi square. HG Infra Engineering Limited (HGIEL) is the contractor. LOA issued March 2026.

title: Widening of Palasuni Bridge — NH-16 from 4 to 6 Lanes
address: Palasuni Bridge and approach road, NH-16, Bhubaneswar
authority: NHAI - National Highways Authority of India
notes: Chronic bottleneck resolved: NHAI and BMC cleared encroaching slum settlement beneath bridge before commencing work in February 2026. Associated 500-metre covered skywalk (₹20 crore) connecting Palasuni and Rasulgarh also planned.

title: Bhubaneswar Metro Rail Phase 1 — Package BBC-03: Viaduct & 6 Stations (Capital Hospital to Acharya Vihar Square)
address: Elevated viaduct from Capital Hospital to Acharya Vihar Square via Railway Station
funding_source: Government of Odisha — State Budget (₹1,000 crore allocated in 2024-25)
notes: Stations: Capital Hospital, Bapuji Nagar, Bhubaneswar Railway Station, Ram Mandir Square, Vani Vihar, Acharya Vihar Square. DMRC was turn-key consultant. Project faced review after political change in 2025; agreement with DMRC terminated March 2026. Construction under review.

title: Bhubaneswar Metro Rail Phase 1 — Package BBC-04: Viaduct & 7 Stations (Jayadev Vihar to KIIT Square)
address: Elevated viaduct from Jayadev Vihar Square to KIIT Square via Patia
notes: Stations: Jayadev Vihar Square, Xavier Square, Rail Sadan, District Centre, Damana Square, Patia Square, KIIT Square. Total Phase 1 project: 26.024 km corridor, 20 elevated stations, DPR cost ₹6,255 crore. Foundation stone laid January 1, 2024.

title: BPIA Airport Link Building — Connecting T1 (Domestic) & T2 (International) Terminals
address: Biju Patnaik International Airport (BPIA), NH-16, Bhubaneswar
notes: 3,360 sq. meter link building inaugurated February 2024. Provides seamless transfers between existing T1 and T2 terminals, eliminating need for passengers to exit the terminal complex.

title: BPIA Airport New Integrated Terminal T3 — 65,000 sqm, Capacity 8.6 MPPA
address: Biju Patnaik International Airport (BPIA), NH-16, Bhubaneswar
funding_source: AAI Capital Budget — Pending final board approval
notes: Standalone integrated T3 to handle both domestic and international under one roof. Design finalized for 65,000 sqm terminal with 6 new aerobridges. Capacity: 8.6 million passengers/year, 3,000 per peak hour. Awaiting AAI board approval.
